column1: # Mail posture of every domain we publish a contact address on, or might.
# Re-verifier: tools/check-mail-domains.sh (queries DNS, run on a schedule — never blocks a deploy)
# Exactly five tab-separated fields per row, no padding, NONE where absent:
# Adding a domain: run the three queries (see check-mail-domains.sh --help), fill in the answer, set
# verified to today. A row whose posture no longer matches reality is a finding in EITHER direction:
# a mail domain losing MX breaks published addresses, and a no-mail domain gaining MX means the
# "never publish an address there" rule has quietly become wrong.
